purpose: Model Tempo enshrined-AMM gas cost paid in any major stablecoin, server-paid fee sponsorship, and net per-tx saving vs card/SWIFT/ACH baselines. Tempo has no native gas token and uses an enshrined protocol AMM, not ERC-4337/Paymaster (art-46). Outputs blended gas cost, sponsorship break-even volume, annual saving, and CFO memo.
